Create the cover illustration for an illustrated folk-tale book, in a square format. Do not write a title or any other text on it.

Picture: Golden autumn light on the Farm. In the foreground, the Farmhand sits on the grey pole fence at the bottom of the meadow, grinning slyly and tossing a big silver coin in the air. Behind him, up the meadow, the Wife stands in the farmhouse door and beckons with a secret smile, and Pål tiptoes across the yard towards her on the toes of his polished shoes, licking his lips.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- the Farmhand: A very skinny, quick lad of about fifteen with a mousy-brown pudding-bowl haircut, a narrow, sunburnt face with a pointed chin, a wide, sly grin and quick green eyes that miss nothing. He wears a baggy, faded brick-red homespun shirt and patched brown knee breeches that are too short for him, so his bony shins show, and goes barefoot. His round grey-green knitted cap with a little tassel is either on his head or waving in his hand.
- the Wife: A pretty, lively farm wife of about thirty-five, of medium height, with a round, dimpled face, a small pointed nose, bright dark-brown eyes under arched eyebrows and wheat-blonde hair in a thick braid coiled at the back of her head and tied with a red ribbon. She wears a sky-blue laced bodice over a pale-yellow blouse with full sleeves, a long red-and-white striped skirt, a big white apron and a string of red glass beads.
- Pål: A soft, round-bellied young man of about twenty-five, shorter than most, with a round, pale, clean-shaven face, plump pink cheeks, a small upturned nose, big, droopy brown eyes and wavy light-brown hair combed into a proud swoop over his forehead. He wears a short brown jacket over a tight lemon-yellow waistcoat with shiny brass buttons straining over his belly, a floppy pink silk neckerchief tied in a big bow, grey knee breeches and polished black buckled shoes, with a carved wooden spoon in his breast pocket.

- the Farm: A small farm on a green hillside in old rural Norway: a dark log farmhouse with a turf roof, a covered porch and small-paned windows; across the yard, a smaller, crooked log cottage and a big grey barn with a wide double door. Below them, a sloping meadow with a fence of slanting grey poles, a winding footpath, a brown ploughed field with a wooden plough, and birch-covered hills beyond.
